notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Island, a basic Forest, a basic Mountain and at least two additional basic lands.
description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve the copy of Early Harvest, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}{R}.
Resolve Early Harvest, untapping all basic lands you control.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of Rootha.
When Lore Drakkis enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Lore Drakkis
uses.cardState: mutated on top of or below Rootha
